title: Register a member
description: Request: `{ "name": string, "email": string }`. Responds 201 with the member (`id`, `name`, `email`, `joinedAt`), or 400 / 409 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: Add a tool
description: Request: `{ "name": string, "description"?: string }`. Responds 201 with the catalog entry (`id`, `name`, `description`, `condition`, `damageNote`, `addedAt`, `status`), or 400 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: List the catalog
description: No request body. Responds 200 with the catalog: an array of each tool's catalog entry (`id`, `name`, `description`, `condition`, `damageNote`, `addedAt`, `status`).
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: Borrow a tool
description: Request: `{ "memberId": number, "toolId": number }`. Responds 201 with the loan (`id`, `memberId`, `toolId`, `borrowedAt`, `dueDate`, `returnedAt`, `returnCondition`, `returnNote`), or 400 / 404 / 409 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`. The checks run in one transaction.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: Return a tool
description: Request: `{ "condition": "good" | "needs_repair", "note"?: string }`. Responds 200 with the returned loan and `late`, or 400 / 404 / 409 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: Report damage to a tool
description: Request: `{ "note": string }`. Responds 200 with the catalog entry (`id`, `name`, `description`, `condition`, `damageNote`, `addedAt`, `status`), or 400 / 404 / 413 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.

title: Mark a tool repaired
description: No request body. Responds 200 with the catalog entry (`id`, `name`, `description`, `condition`, `damageNote`, `addedAt`, `status`), or 404 / 409 with an error `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its API requirements.
